name: Takabane Sae
source:
"Zanma Rouga... prepare yourself!" 

 A female ninja who carries out all orders. She believes what people say without question. She is from the Kanga Ninja School, which was merged with the Iga due to falling membership. She is on a secret mission to stay with Rouga, but.... Her breasts and butt are rather large in comparison to her height. She pours her heart and soul into carrying out the orders of her masters. 

 Battle quote - "I shall show you here.... the skill of a ninja."
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
